hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Splitting a number into two components of sum x with cost a * b exhibits an invariant.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The total sum of pairwise products required to partition n into all ones is invariant under split sequence.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The resulting total cost is always n * (n - 1) // 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minCostToSplit(n: int) -> int:
    return n * (n - 1) // 2
```

complexity.notes: Direct formula evaluation in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive splitting creates an unnecessary recursion tree for an invariant quantity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes the algebraic invariant property of binary splitting.
